name: portfolio-copytoclipboard
title: Copytoclipboard
description: Copy text to the clipboard and report interaction feedback.
docs: Imported from the portfolio project. Customize personal copy, links, social profiles, booking URLs, and data before use. Requires React 19, Next.js 16, Tailwind CSS 4, and shadcn theme variables. Files install under your components alias in lazy-ui/, with their relative imports preserved. Mount react-hot-toast Toaster once in your application.
